text: The Chinese Language major (professional Code: 050102) belongs to the category of Chinese Language and Literature. It is a humanities and social science major that takes the Chinese language itself as its research object and takes into account both language application and cultural inheritance. This major focuses on the study of the systematic rules of Chinese phonetics, vocabulary, grammar, and writing, while also emphasizing the practical application of language in social communication, literary creation, and cultural dissemination. It serves as a bridge connecting traditional Chinese culture with modern language life.
